key_insight: The paper integrates order dispatching and routing into one framework, using a learned routing oracle to make real-time last-mile pickup decisions more effective and scalable.
engineering_relevance: This is directly relevant to logistics platforms because it targets fast, operationally feasible decision-making for large, variable-scale pickup systems.
method: Dynamic-Residual Graph Attention Network encoder for routing subproblems.
Look-Ahead Courier-Personalized decoder to produce near-optimal routing guidance.
Routing-oracle-guided dispatching heuristic with local search for real-time courier selection.
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated on real-world Cainiao Logistics datasets using both offline testing and online rolling-horizon simulation, and it outperformed benchmarks in solution quality and solving time.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and stability of the learned routing oracle, so deployment may require careful retraining and validation as demand patterns change.
paper_title: Integrated Order Dispatching and Routing for Last-Mile Pickup via Deep Reinforcement Learning
